additional_telemetry_names.basis: Approved as an aero-package alias inheriting the verified base controls; this configuration has not been separately live-tested.

confidence_notes: Gen1 and Gen2 were directly tested. Six paddle-selected gears, clutch-free move-off, no-lift full-throttle upshifts, perceptible automatic cut, clutch-free downshifts, visible automatic-blip throttle spikes, and the closed GT/Formula display rim were confirmed. The simulator mechanism responsible for clutch-free move-off was not established.
scope_notes: One shared telemetry-name record covers LMP2 and LMP2_Gen1. Oreca 07 - Low Downforce is approved as an exact aero-package alias with inherited controls; its behavior was not separately live-tested. The rim shape was remapped from the retired "prototype" value to "gt-style" by definition, without observing the rim again.
